tv: TCL 55" 4K Google TV, 2023 (G10, G10_4K_US_NF); also TCL 55P6K, Spain and TCL 43P69K, Netherlands (G10_4K_GB_NF_32BIT); and TCL 55Q651G, US (G10_4K_US_NF); and TCL 55Q6CS, India (G10_4K_GB); and TCL 55C6KS, Italy (G10_4K_GB); and TCL 55C69B, France (G10_4K_GB); and TCL 55QM5K, US (G10_4K_US_NF); and TCL S551G, US (G10_4K_US_NF); and TCL Smart TV (G10_4K_GB_NF_32BIT, Android 14 AU02)
notes: TCL TV+, TCL Live, store demo, smartlink installer; setupwraith also claims Home once the stock launcher is disabled; on the Netherlands 43P69K, Samba TV ACR, logkit and ttvs shipped enabled (disabled and reboot-checked), setupwraith owned the setup Wi-Fi (re-join first), and dreamx was re-enabled to keep the screensaver menu; on the US 55Q651G, Samba TV ACR and logkit shipped enabled too, and with no antenna channels TCL Live is Live TV's only source; unit-specific packages are optional; on the India 55Q6CS the same telemetry shipped enabled, setupwraith owned the Wi-Fi, and the remote's Input (4514) and Dashboard (4001) need the key helpers, which cost the held-volume ramp; on a C6KS (G10_4K_GB) with launcherx disabled, the app buttons and the gear are dead; a log-reading accessibility service (READ_LOGS, not in this repo) brings them back and keeps the held-volume ramp ([note](../docs/devices/tcl-g10-app-keys.md)); on the US 55QM5K every package of this list is installed and it ships hotelmenu, a Roku ad-SDK and US streaming preloads (optional block at the end), ttvs hosts the firmware updater (kept), setupwraith owned the setup Wi-Fi (re-join first), casting still worked with the wizard off, and its BT_RC923A remote sends scancodes, not keycodes: the folder's config.json maps the app buttons, while the gear needs settings_key_scancodes, a config.xml-only key; on a TCL Smart TV (G10_4K_GB_NF_32BIT, Android 14 / UTT2.250416.001 AU02) with a third-party Home, launcherx and setupwraith both had to be disabled — setupwraith's translucent RecoveryActivity stacked as Home and blanked the screen until it was off; Home and Input worked from the real remote, Netflix/YouTube/gear stayed dead, Input opens com.tcl.suspension's quick panel as an overlay, and all 20 disabled packages, Home and Wi-Fi held across one reboot
